name: default
description: Standard single-model LLM serving benchmark suite. Seven workloads cover production chat, production prefix caching, RAG sessions, code/repo tasks, long-context pressure, agentic tool sessions, and synthetic cache controls.

harness.reason: AIPerf supports fixed-schedule replay, request-rate and concurrency modes, YAML configs, custom datasets, production trace formats, prefix synthesis, raw payload replay, and headless reports.

workloads.name: Production chat traffic
workloads.description: Bursty production-like chat traffic with varied input lengths and realistic user prompts.

traffic_sources.name: Azure LLM Inference Trace 2024
traffic_sources.notes: High-variance 25-minute conversation trace window with timestamps and context-token lengths.

prompt_sources.name: ShareGPT
prompt_sources.notes: Chat content pool rendered from conversation/message arrays.

prompt_sources.name: WildChat
prompt_sources.notes: Real-user chat corpus rendered from conversation/message arrays.

workloads.name: Production prefix-cache replay
workloads.description: Qwen Bailian production traces with session structure and cache block hashes.

traffic_sources.name: Qwen Bailian usage traces
traffic_sources.notes: Includes timestamp, input length, output length, chat ids, turns, request type, and hash ids for KV blocks.

prompt_sources.name: Deterministic block renderer
prompt_sources.notes: Generated text chunks keyed by trace hash ids so repeated blocks become repeated prompt text.

workloads.name: RAG cache and session replay
workloads.description: RAG-style repeated components with system prompts, retrieved passages, chat history, and user questions.

traffic_sources.name: RAGPulse
traffic_sources.notes: RAG workload trace with timestamps, input/output lengths, session ids, and hashed prompt components.

prompt_sources.name: RAGPulse
prompt_sources.notes: RAG records rendered from system, retrieved context, history, and question fields.

workloads.name: Code generation, editing, and repo tasks
workloads.description: Code-heavy prompts ranging from edit contexts to issue-solving and function-level generation.

traffic_sources.name: Azure LLM Inference Trace 2024
traffic_sources.notes: High-variance 25-minute code trace window with timestamps and context-token lengths.

prompt_sources.name: Blazedit
prompt_sources.notes: Code edit prompts with several-thousand-character code contexts.

prompt_sources.name: SWE-bench Lite
prompt_sources.notes: Repository issue tasks rendered from repo, instance id, base commit, problem statement, and hints.

prompt_sources.name: BigCodeBench
prompt_sources.notes: Practical function-level code generation tasks with complex instructions and library usage.

workloads.name: Long context and memory pressure
workloads.description: Production long-context requests at 16k tokens and above, including dense 30k+ and 40k+ tails, to stress prefill, KV memory, and decode batching.

traffic_sources.name: Mooncake ArXiv production trace
traffic_sources.notes: High-variance 25-minute production window selected from the ArXiv trace after filtering to requests with at least 16k input tokens.

prompt_sources.name: LongBench v2
prompt_sources.notes: Long-context tasks with contexts from 8k to 2M words across document, dialogue, code repo, and structured-data domains.

prompt_sources.name: InfiniteBench
prompt_sources.notes: Very long context tasks, useful for 40k+ token prompt pools.

prompt_sources.name: RULER
prompt_sources.notes: Synthetic exact-length long-context generator for 32k, 64k, and larger windows.

workloads.name: Tool-heavy agent sessions
workloads.description: Multi-turn tool-use sessions replayed from timed tau2 assistant LLM calls with tool-call markers.

traffic_sources.name: tau2-bench
traffic_sources.notes: Timed airline and retail result traces with assistant turns, prompt-token usage, and tool interactions.

prompt_sources.name: tau-bench
prompt_sources.notes: Tool-agent tasks rendered into next-call prompts with tool/state context.

prompt_sources.name: tau2-bench
prompt_sources.notes: Customer-service agent tasks across domains with tool interaction structure.

workloads.name: Synthetic cache controls
workloads.description: High-cache-sharing and low-cache-sharing control workload with exact prompt reuse ratios.

traffic_sources.name: Synthetic phased arrivals
traffic_sources.notes: Deterministic phases for low, medium, and bursty request rates.

prompt_sources.name: Synthetic prefix generator
prompt_sources.notes: Generates exact shared-prefix groups and unique suffixes.

sweeps.description: Replay each workload at increasing time-compression multipliers to find max sustainable goodput.
Closed-loop concurrency sweep for raw saturation diagnostics.
Trace-preserving RPS/QPS ramp generated at run time with --target-rps and --ramp-steps.
